formal: Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering
summary: The Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering is a key academic unit dedicated to advancing scientific and technological progress in engineering. Its mission encompasses education, innovation, and technology transfer, addressing contemporary challenges and opportunities. The Department focuses on a broad spectrum of research areas, including telecommunications, artificial intelligence, robotics, and biomedical applications, aiming to drive advancements in these critical fields.
description:
The Department of Electrical, Computer and Biomedical Engineering is an interdisciplinary academic and research unit committed to fostering innovation and knowledge dissemination in various engineering disciplines. The Department's core mission is to serve as a catalyst for scientific and technological development, providing high-quality education and facilitating technology transfer to industry and society.

Research activities within the Department span a wide array of cutting-edge fields. These include the development of advanced telecommunication systems, intelligent solutions in artificial intelligence and data science, and innovative applications in robotics and industrial automation. Furthermore, the Department explores areas such as biomedical engineering, microelectronics, photonics, and high-performance computing, contributing to both fundamental understanding and practical applications. The Department is dedicated to addressing complex engineering challenges and contributing to societal progress through its diverse research portfolio.
